newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal -Basis offers fall, CBOT rallies.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal -Basis offers fall, CBOT rallies.

text.p: A runup in CBOT soymeal futures has squelched demand from end-users on Monday and some basis offers dropped as a result," U.S. soymeal brokers said.
"The board (CBOT) just keeps running up and they can't get anything sold," said a southeast dealer. "People are just tired of paying these high prices."
Greater-than-expected weekly soybean export inspections pushed prices higher early Monday. At 1031 CDT, May soymeal was up $3.70 per ton at $308.30.
A river dealer said that there was little meal moving in export channels, but some more business could be on the way.
"Things are pretty slow here so far, but there could be a little more activity later today (Monday)," the dealer said.
